purpose: Falsify a persistent E2E meta-training mechanism; not reproduce the large paper or establish the full architecture.
primary: Final-cycle competence is a prerequisite; compare return first-cycle NLL/correctness separately from reacquisition and all-token NLL. No inference of retention after a failed acquisition gate.
controls: Identical initialization and exact ordered training tokens per seed. Equal observations, not equal FLOPs/time. All inner/outer fitting and evaluation costs are charged. Last-observed-transition table is an information-matched specialized control.
selection: All seeds/arms execute fixed128 updates. Final checkpoint only. No scored-data hyperparameter choice or stopping. Preflight uses distinct seeds and smaller budgets.
